title: Spicy Irish Sushi Rolls with Grapes
description: A unique fusion of Irish and Japanese flavors. Sweet grapes add a refreshing twist to the spicy sushi rolls.
instructions: 1. Prepare spicy Irish sauce by mixing together 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sriracha, and 1 tsp honey. Stir until smooth.
2. Cut the sushi nori sheets in half lengthwise.
3. Lay a nori sheet flat and spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto it.
4. Place a spoonful of spicy Irish sauce and cream cheese mixture on the rice.
5. Arrange the grapes, cucumber, and avocado on top of the sauce.
6. Roll the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat or a clean tea towel.
7. Slice the roll into 8 equal pieces.
8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.
